name: Mukimo
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 cups pumpkin leaves, spinach, or kale, chopped

steps: Place the potatoes, maize, and peas in a large pot and cover with water.
Bring to a boil and cook until the potatoes are tender.
Add the chopped vegetables and continue cooking for 5–10 minutes.
Mash all the ingredients together until well combined.
Serve hot with beef stew, chicken stew, or grilled meat.

culture.text: Mukimo or mokimo is a traditional Kenyan meal prepared by mashing potatoes and green vegetables. It may also include maize and beans. Mukimo is mostly served as an accompaniment for meat-based stew and nyama choma. Though originally from the central part of Kenya, mukimo is now consumed amongst various communities in Kenya.
